description.value: At the end of each of their turns, the warden can dump a trauma stim and take [[/damage 10]] damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can’t be reduced in any way.

If a creature within 10 squares presents proof of Krael’s corruption aloud — his real ledger, a recording, the name of a flat he sold — the warden loses their damage immunities, any nondamaging effects of their signature ability, and their Flag Your SIN triggered action until the end of the encounter.

Each ally within 12 squares of the warden can then make a free strike against a target of the warden’s choice.
